tests.html:
The editor's optional interval fields — ramp, cadence, and both left empty

One new workout with three intervals covers all three cases. Build it once, save it, then ride it to read the cockpit halves.

Procedure

  1. Ramp. Add an interval and set "End Power (%)" to a different value from "Power (%)". Save. The terrain graph draws that interval as a diagonal ramp rather than a stepped block.
  2. Cadence. Add an interval carrying a "Cadence (RPM)" value. Start the workout. TARGET RPM appears in the cockpit's cadence metric while that interval runs.
  3. Both left empty. Add an interval with "End Power" and "Cadence" both blank. It saves, and it rides as a normal flat interval with no cadence target shown.

(Partially automated: WorkoutEditorViewModelTest.addRamp_inserts_a_ramp_with_targetPowerEndPercent covers ramp construction, …updateInterval_replaces_the_indexed_entry covers the cadence field round-trip, and the same class covers default-interval construction. The terrain diagonal, the cockpit TARGET RPM and the no-target fallback all stay visual.)

Expect

  • Step 1: the ramp interval draws as a diagonal on the terrain graph.
  • Step 2: TARGET RPM shows in the cockpit's cadence metric while that interval runs.
  • Step 3: the blank interval saves and rides flat, with no cadence target shown.

TST-0061-Editor-Empty-Optional-Fields an interval with both optional fields empty saves and rides flat step 3

frontmatter.title: A remembered device reconnects from its Equipment Hub row

tests.html:
A remembered device reconnects from its Equipment Hub row

Purpose

Verifies how a remembered trainer and heart-rate strap come back after a relaunch since PHASE-025: through the Equipment Hub and the equipment icons in the top bar. TST-0593-Remembered-Device-Survives-Relaunch-ISS-0364 described this on the Workouts-page panel before it was split down to its defect.

Setup

A rider with a trainer and a heart-rate strap bound, both switched on. Test on both platforms.

Steps

  1. Force-quit the app, relaunch it and pick the rider. Watch the equipment icons at the end of the top bar.
  2. Switch the trainer off and on again so it drops. Open the Equipment Hub by tapping any equipment icon, and read the Smart Trainer row.
  3. Tap Reconnect on the row.
  4. Repeat steps 2 and 3 with the heart-rate strap.

Expect

  • Step 1: the trainer and heart-rate icons turn from faint grey with a slash to the bar's text colour without a tap. No picker opens.
  • Step 2: the row names the remembered trainer, reads Disconnected, and carries a Reconnect button.
  • Step 3: it connects without a picker, the row reads Connected, and the trainer icon is back in the bar's text colour with no slash.
  • Step 4: the same holds for the strap.

tests.title: Workouts and History carry the four destinations and the equipment icons

frontmatter.title: Workouts and History carry the four destinations and the equipment icons

tests.html:
Workouts and History carry the four destinations and the equipment icons

Purpose

Verifies how Workouts and History reach the rest of the app since PHASE-025, which is what TST-0596-Chrome-Reachable-From-Every-Pre-Ride described before it was split down to its defects. The two screens now share one navigation container and one top bar, on both platforms.

Setup

Any rider with a trainer bound and switched off at the start. A phone under 600 dp wide and a tablet at or above it. Test on both platforms.

Steps

  1. Open Workouts on the phone and read the bottom bar and the top bar.
  2. Tap History in the bottom bar, then Workouts, then History again. Press Back.
  3. From History, tap the rider item in the bottom bar, then Profile. On Android, Profile is the button under the current rider's card. On iOS it is next to Switch rider. Then tap Settings in the bottom bar.
  4. Switch the trainer on and watch the top bar. Then switch it off again.
  5. Repeat steps 1 to 3 on the tablet.

Expect

  • Step 1: bar order: rider (mark in rider's colour, name in bar colour), Workouts, History, Settings. Top bar: no gear or rider chip; four equipment icons last.
  • Step 2: each tap swaps the screen in place. Back lands on the Riders list, not back through Workouts and History.
  • Step 3: the current rider's profile opens. Settings opens as its own destination.
  • Step 4: on connect the trainer icon turns the bar's text colour, no slash. On drop it turns faint grey and slashed, on both screens.
  • Step 5: the same four destinations sit in a left rail, Settings at its foot.

Not this check

  • The whole session across the container, including the ride-mode strip and reduced motion: TST-0666-TheNavigationContainerCarriesARiderThroughAWholeSession.
  • What the equipment icons and the attention bar do around a ride: TST-0667-FromAFinishedRideToTheNextStart.
  • That Settings, the profile and the Riders list stay reachable at all, whatever the layout: TST-0596-Chrome-Reachable-From-Every-Pre-Ride.

Provenance

Step 4 was rewritten on 2026-09-30 by TASK-1018-TheChecksParityMatrixGlossaryAndGalleriesForTheSlashAndTheBottomBar for FEAT-0132: a trainer that is not connected is drawn faint grey with a slash, not plain grey (REQ-0235-ADeviceThatIsNotConnectedIsDrawnWithASlashInTheTopBarAndEveryHubRow).

Step 4 was rewritten on 2026-09-28 for FEAT-0130: a connected icon is drawn in the bar's text colour, no longer green (REQ-0224-TheTopBarDrawsAllFourEquipmentIconsAndOnlyAFailureIsInColour).

Split out of TST-0596-Chrome-Reachable-From-Every-Pre-Ride on 2026-09-22 (tools/instructions/TESTING.md, "When to invalidate"): the regression test kept the defects' assertion, and this check took the description of the current screens.

tests.html:
From a finished ride to the next start

Purpose

Verifies the equipment flow DES-0002 sections 2 to 4 describe as one sequence: the indicators, the attention bar, the connecting state, the gate, the Hub in both modes, and the teardown. TST-0666-TheNavigationContainerCarriesARiderThroughAWholeSession tests the navigation joins and touches equipment only in passing; this check is where the equipment claims are asserted.

Setup

A phone under 600 dp wide on the release candidate, then a tablet for steps 4 to 9. Four slots filled, with a power source that can be powered down for steps 7 and 8. A mock device cannot be powered down. On Android, turn on Fake a connected trainer in Developer Options and restart, keep Mock Wahoo KICKR in Smart Trainer, bind the physical KICKR in Power Source and as the Cadence source, and a real strap or Mock HRM Strap in Heart Rate. On iOS, Use mock trainer with Mock Wahoo KICKR, Mock Power Meter as power and cadence source and Mock HRM Strap fills the four slots for steps 1 to 6 and 9, but no bench device gives a droppable power source there, so steps 7 and 8 wait for one. One rider.

Steps

  1. Open Workout Selection with all four devices bound and connected. Read the top bar.
  2. Tap the heart-rate indicator.
  3. In the Hub, tap the Cadence row and read its sheet. Close it, then tap the Smart Trainer row.
  4. Back on Workout Selection, start a structured Power workout, let it run one minute, then discard it.
  5. Read Workout Selection: the indicators and what sits beneath them.
  6. Tap Reconnect.
  7. Power the power meter down. Pick a structured Power workout.
  8. Tap Cancel, then power the power meter up and pick the workout again.
  9. In the cockpit, tap the cadence indicator; then pause the ride and tap it again.

Expect

  • Step 1: four indicators at the end, in the bar's text colour, none green. No rider chip, gear or kebab. The sparkle shows only on FREE.
  • Step 2: the Hub opens directly: Smart Trainer, Power, Cadence, Heart Rate, each naming its device and reading Connected.
  • Step 3: each opens a sheet with Sends, Change device and Forget. The trainer's adds Resistance and Run the compatibility test.
  • Step 4: the workout starts once every device it needs is connected. Discarding it returns to Workout Selection.
  • Step 5: every bound indicator is faint grey with a slash, and no dot. Beneath: equipment not connected, with one action, Reconnect. No row reads Connected.
  • Step 6: all four indicators turn the app accent, then the bar's text colour, with no further tap.
  • Step 7: a Connecting state beneath the indicators names the power source. The cockpit does not open.
  • Step 8: after Cancel, the library with nothing selected. On the second pick the cockpit opens once the power source connects.
  • Step 9: running, a sheet with no chevrons where only Reconnect and cadence's Change source respond, and the timer counts. Paused: the full Hub.

Not this check

  • The bar, rail and destinations: TST-0666-TheNavigationContainerCarriesARiderThroughAWholeSession.
  • The cadence sensor's own binding rules and its mid-ride switch: TST-0657-ACadenceSensorFillsTheFourthSlot, whose step 12 now tests the paused path.
  • Whether watts change source when the power meter drops, which is the open question on ISS-0493.
  • The heart-rate prompt's fate on Power and Route, which is REQ-0216's open decision; test whichever Edwin chose.
  • Each row and sheet of the Hub in depth: TST-0674-TheEquipmentHubListSetsUpInspectsAndForgetsADevice.

Provenance

  • 2026-09-30, TASK-1018-TheChecksParityMatrixGlossaryAndGalleriesForTheSlashAndTheBottomBar: step 5 expects every bound indicator slashed, because a device that is not connected is now drawn faint grey with a slash (REQ-0235-ADeviceThatIsNotConnectedIsDrawnWithASlashInTheTopBarAndEveryHubRow). Step 6 still holds: the accent while connecting, then the bar's text colour.
  • 2026-09-28: Steps 1, 3, 6 and 9 used to expect green and amber indicators, the cadence slot's overflow menu with Device info, and a reconnect-only Hub drawn full-screen. Step 3 now opens the details sheets that replaced the overflow and Device info, and step 9 the sheet the running ride gets. Since FEAT-0130 the Hub is a list of rows, a connected device's icon is drawn in the bar's text colour rather than green, connecting is the app accent, and only a failed connect is red with a dot (REQ-0224-TheTopBarDrawsAllFourEquipmentIconsAndOnlyAFailureIsInColour, REQ-0225-TheEquipmentHubIsAListGroupedByBikeAndRider).
